feature: Transform overlay, key overlay, graph and animated-only tracks, as mocks
summary: A live mock page draws what you described: a glass bar of typeable transform values beside a layer while you handle it, the same bar beside a key you click, a graph where you pick segments and add points, and a track that lists only what is animated. One card asks when a change on a layer with keys becomes a key.
setup: Mock page only, no app change: open http://127.0.0.1:8791/index.html#video-animate (Prototype, Video, Animate with the overlay). Every part of it is live in the browser. The pictures are photographs of that page, since this task changed no app code.

try.do: In the editor at the top, drag the title, then a corner, then the knob above it. Watch the bar under it.
Rest on the knob and drag its flat green arc sideways: Tilt X, Tilt Y and Depth join the bar, and a Tilt Y row joins the track.
Click the second diamond on the Opacity row, type 40 and press Return.
Click the word Opacity in the track and press Delete; then right-click the clip and choose Animate, Opacity.
Right-click the Rotation row (after turning the title) and choose Show Graph.
In The graph section, click the second segment, right-click it and pick Ease out back; double-click the first segment to add a point.
Answer the card on the dashboard: When you change something on a layer that already has keys, when should the change become a key?

evaluate: Is under the object the right home for the bar, or would you rather it sat in one fixed place at the top of the canvas?
Should Reset leave position alone, as drawn, or put the layer back in the middle too?
On the graph, is a plain click picking the segment and a double-click adding a point the right split, or do you want a plain click to add a point?
Is a hollow diamond on the clip's key line the right result of Add Key on a layer with nothing animated yet?
Does the panel keeping Position & Size beside the bar feel right, now that its 3D section is gone?
rough: No mock covered these surfaces before: this page is the first for the bar, the key bar and the animated-only track.
video.html draws the value graph in the right panel; it stays in the row's lane as you chose on 2026-09-26 (card a-keyed-value-s-curve-opens-where-you-want-it-where-should-a-keyed-value-s-cur).
The bar's angle label is a small angle sign; the app may draw the system's angle symbol instead. The overlay build task decides (a-small-overlay-shows-transform-values-to-type-i).
The bar says Tilt X and Tilt Y where the app's rows still say Rotation X and Rotation Y; the overlay build task renames them everywhere (a-small-overlay-shows-transform-values-to-type-i).
A key bar over a key on the top row sits on the clip beside it and can hide the clip's key line there; it never covers the key itself.
Add Key making an empty key moment needs something the app's model does not have yet; the last build task owns it (a-layer-s-track-shows-only-what-is-animated-and).
